instruction.title: Seat prompt
instruction.body: Randy is the operator and the relay. He pastes, carries reports, and says go or no-go. He is not the seam chair. The seam chair is the CLI repair role on forge. It stays cold until he relays a repair. Device is eyes and hands. Device updates public/cli.json. Web is intel. Web reads this map, then writes marks, notes, and plans only in public/web.json. Web does not edit public/cli.json. Three systems, not three brains. PANOPTES is the workflow. SIFT excavates saved sessions and does not take over a live file by being found. Raphael is the local intelligence at ~/midas-agent. INGOT builder plus capsule is one seal tool outside the three. A dug file is evidence of a path.

messages.body: File map of the three is in systems[].files. Counts match the earlier look: PANOPTES 635, SIFT 832, midas-agent 81. ~/SIFT does not exist. Recommendations are not extra roots on the map yet.

OPUS_ARCHITECT_PROMPT_v1.0.md sha256 fb92775e73b062899b823492dd65296fc91ce2b41f71576b7e8d17b0df96b18e in PANOPTES offsite PROTOCOLS snapshot 20260813 and in SIFT prompts/. The two Raphael .pytest_cache/README.md files are sha256 73fd6fccdd802c419a6b2d983d6c3173b7da97558ac4b589edec2dfe443db9ad. That README is pytest's own cache note and says not to commit it. The two 37-byte .gitignore files are the same bytes. sha256 3ed731b65d06150c138e2dadb0be0697550888a6b47eb8c45ecc9adba8b8e9bd. Paths: ~/midas-agent/.pytest_cache/.gitignore and ~/midas-agent/midas_agent/.pytest_cache/.gitignore. Both say they were created by pytest and ignore everything in that directory. Nothing deleted. The other .gitignore sizes remain different files.

SIFT prompts/ hashed, 20 files, sha256 now on those rows. The 13 files that are not bak each have a different hash. 36 top files hashed on forge and stamped. 19 PANOPTES slate and law files, 7 SIFT doctrine files, 10 Raphael plan files. No backup hash matches its live file. Bodies not copied. web.json not edited.

Full map plan is PLAN.md. 1548 files on the map. 64 have a sha256. The rest get a hash in the order in that file. A hash is not a reading. results/ gets hashes and does not get turned into law. PROTOCOLS stays off the charts until Randy relays it. Web notes stay in web.json.

STRATA is the hasher. Forge ~/STRATA, also on two at ~/000-MIDAS-000/STRATA. Phase 1 writes sha256 and does not write inside the target. 18 runs were read. None target ~/PANOPTES, ~/000-INGATHERING-000/SIFT, or ~/midas-agent. The live v2.8 hash is not in those manifests. June runs are not stamped onto these rows. Phase 1 scans are complete. lane-panoptes-20260924 hashed 9865 files. The map has 635 because .git and virtualenvs were skipped. lane-sift-20260924 hashed 832 files, the same count as the map. lane-raphael-20260924 hashed 6579 files. The map has 81.
